value.rationale: A motivated sharp exact solution of both recently introduced invariants on the natural family of triangle bouquets. The 4m threshold is genuinely above the source independence bound 3m+1 and below its generic sufficient bound; the proof identifies the precise cost of cleaning paired peripheral residues.
